hypothesis: Align source reading units to the existing 1000-character excerpt ceiling using native paragraphs/sentences, reducing clipped facts under the same retrieval/read budgets.
scope: QASPER TRAIN development; fresh paper IDs relative to 92 known exposed TRAIN papers; not independent confirmation, holdout, or formal Experiment.
primary: Answer token F1, max across human reference answers, all 70 planned questions per arm; failed/invalid/not-attempted = 0. Paper-clustered 5000 bootstrap paired difference, seed fixed.
secondary: original human evidence paragraph visibility (strict substring proxy, not semantic sufficiency)
input/output tokens and warm end-to-end p95
per-arm ingestion/index cost and chunk count
stop_rules: After current AgentRun if fallback is attempted: retain outcomes and stop further batch; no single-model quality claim.
Stop after current run for unconfirmed transport, wrong raw model, source/arm/snapshot mismatch, non-400 provider error, invalid frozen request or budget ceiling.
Stop at eight failed Runs. Never silently retry/resume unknown outcomes.
No prompt/parameter rescue after seeing scores; preserve all planned missing rows as zero.
causal_limit: Compound chunk-policy comparison: boundary, maximum size, and overlap differ together. No boundary-only causal claim.
deployment: Structural builder is internal opt-in only. Existing worker and production default remain fixed. Stop this milestone after acceptance outcome.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
